title: API: cached read endpoints on Vercel (/api/now, /api/day, /api/month, /api/daily)
description: Read layer between the browser and Supabase. Vercel api/ routes in the frontend project read Supabase with the secret key (Vercel env vars only, never in client code). Fixed endpoints, no free queries: /api/now (latest), /api/day?date=YYYY-MM-DD, /api/month?month=YYYY-MM, /api/daily (all days since install, ~365 rows/year). Cache-Control s-maxage: 60 s for now/today/current month; long (hours/days) for closed days/months since the past never changes. Strict param validation (format, no unknown params, no future dates, none before install) and 400 otherwise, so bots cannot bust the cache with random query strings. Device chosen by env var (bench vs station). Optional later: Vercel firewall rate limit per IP (check what the free plan includes).

title: Firmware: sensor self-check (boot + 's' on serial)
description: Print per-sensor status at boot and on demand: BME280 range, vane ADC disconnected threshold, reed pins idle HIGH + counts since boot, WiFi RSSI, time. Rules in a pure lib with native tests.

title: Backend: Supabase migrations + ingest Edge Function
description: readings, hourly, daily tables, RLS, pg_cron aggregates, ingest function with validation. Decide public vs restricted read.
notes: Decisions 2026-10-08 (revised): one Supabase project (no dev/prod split). No login for readers. Tables have NO select policy for anon: the publishable/anon key reads nothing. Reads go only through the Vercel API layer (meteo-b2c) using the Supabase secret key server-side. Scope here: readings, readings_hourly, readings_daily, pg_cron aggregates, RLS, ingest Edge Function (x-device-key). No read RPCs. Bench vs station separated by device_id (meteo-station-bench vs meteo-station-1). Deploy straight to remote (no local supabase start). Folder: backend/.

title: Firmware: 1-minute reading + JSON payload over serial
description: Integrate all sensors, print the JSON that would be sent each minute. Rain = mm in the minute, not cumulative.

title: Firmware: WiFi connect + auto-reconnect
description: Connect with credentials from secrets.h, print IP and RSSI over serial, auto-reconnect. User flashes and verifies.

title: Firmware: sensor modules (bme280, wind, rain, vane)
description: ISR counters with debounce (anemometer 5 ms, rain 10 ms, validate), forced-mode BME280, vane 20-sample avg + nearest of 8 positions, circular mean, 3 s gust.
notes: Done: BME280, anemometer. Next: rain gauge, then vane (vane_math lib + tests already written, uncommitted).

title: Firmware: NTP time sync (UTC)
description: Sync via NTP, never emit readings without valid time.

title: Firmware: config.h + secrets.h scaffold
description: Create include/config.h (pins, intervals, calibration: 0.2794 mm/tip, 0.667 m/s per Hz, vane table, offset) and real secrets.h from secrets.example.h (user fills credentials).

title: Firmware: bench and station PlatformIO envs with their own DEVICE_ID
description: Two envs in platformio.ini via build_flags: bench -> meteo-station-bench, station -> meteo-station-1. Flash with pio run -e station -t upload.

title: Firmware: OTA updates
description: Include OTA from first flash; consider rollback.

title: Firmware: RAM buffer, batch HTTPS POST, watchdog
description: Buffer pending readings, batch POST with x-device-key, retry on WiFi return, watchdog, reboot if long without sending.

title: Docs: update spec with validated bench data
description: 0x77, RJ11 wiring, WAGO, colors, 8-direction vane, debounce, plate mounting, fill Amazon links.

title: Frontend: React/TS dashboard
description: Now, 24h, history, rain, wind rose, UV from Open-Meteo.
notes: Decision 2026-10-08: display times in fixed Europe/Madrid (station time), not the viewer's browser zone. Data stays UTC end to end; convert only when rendering.
